create_image_processor: create an RT-DETR image processor that converts COCO annotations and resizes images for object detection
run_object_detection: run object detection on an image using RT-DETR and return bounding boxes with class labels and confidence scores
build_detection_model: build an RT-DETR object detection model with a backbone, hybrid encoder, and decoder for iterative bounding box refinement
test_denoising_training: test contrastive denoising training by adding noise to ground-truth labels and bounding boxes for robust detection
summarize_decoder_output: summarize RT-DETR decoder output including intermediate hidden states, reference points, and predicted bounding boxes
